name: runbook-generator
description: Writes a step-by-step operational runbook from a service description (what it is, what it depends on, how it fails) or an incident transcript (what responders actually ran) that you paste into the chat: when to use it, before you start, read-only triage and diagnosis checks, mitigation ordered least disruptive first with a rollback for every state-changing step, verification, escalation and after-incident steps. Every command is classified in code as read-only, state-changing or destructive; each step says whether it came from your text or is suggested. Hosts, URLs, numbers and contacts that are not in your text stay visible placeholders to fill in. Follow-ups: checks only, rollback only, high-risk only, shorter, show sources, fill in <NAME> = value, add a step for X, as json. It never runs anything and reads only what you paste: no general questions.

skills.name: Write a runbook
skills.description: An operational runbook (triage, diagnosis, mitigation with rollbacks, verification, escalation) from a pasted service description or incident transcript, with code-classified command safety, provenance per step and placeholders for unknowns.
examples: Runbook for when the orders DB pool is exhausted: <describe the service>
Make a runbook from this incident channel log: <paste the transcript>
